args.message:
Fix round_money to use ROUND_HALF_EVEN per FIN-212

The docstring already claimed banker's rounding, but the implementation
used ROUND_HALF_UP, causing the nightly build to fail in
tests/test_money.py. Switch the quantize call to ROUND_HALF_EVEN.

args.body:
## Summary
Nightly build failure: `tests/test_money.py` expects banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN, per FIN-212), but `round_money()` in `src/money.py` implemented ROUND_HALF_UP despite its docstring claiming otherwise.

## Changes
- Switched `quantize(...)` rounding mode from `ROUND_HALF_UP` to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` in `src/money.py`.

## Verification
- CI run ci-0001 on this branch: **passed**.

Please approve so this can ship in today's release.
args.head: fix/fin-212-bankers-rounding
args.title: Implement banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) in round_money per FIN-212
